definitions.DIRECTIONALLY_ACCURATE: Policy realism + valid codes/levers/scope for Representative Payer demo; BCBS NC exact fidelity NOT required; OPERATIONALLY_APPROVED prohibited.
definitions.DEMO_READY: Directionally accurate AND evidence pathway classified as EMPIRICAL_COHORT | REPRESENTATIVE_SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE | PROVENANCE_ONLY (not BLOCKED). Executable scenario bounded and labeled.
definitions.BLOCKED_PATHWAY: Lane B: cannot run numerical mechanism — missing codeset/definition/inputs/cohort. Persisting BLOCKED is orchestration success, NOT mechanism execution success.
definitions.DIRECTIONAL_FAIL: Lane A: unresolved proprietary/licensed inputs (NDC/MCG/MUE/rates/placeholders) or lever FAIL — do not invent authoritative rules.
definitions.ORCHESTRATION_COMPLETED: Worker/job pathway finished and persisted a typed evidence record (empirical | synthetic | provenance | blocked). ≠ numerical analysis success.

separate_conditions_note: nonzero cohort ≠ inputs sufficient ≠ empirical eligible. These are sequential gates, not interchangeable.

reconcile_48_vs_22.explanation: Blocked (Lane B) = cannot execute numerical analysis with current inputs/cohort. Directional fail (Lane A) = definition/codeset unresolved or lever FAIL. A policy can be directionally OK but blocked for analytics (e.g. missing scope.states for coded empirical path), or both.

reconcile_267_vs_241.explanation: DEMO_READY requires directional PASS plus a non-BLOCKED evidence pathway. The gap is primarily directionally accurate policies still classified BLOCKED for mechanism execution.
